entries.title: Proverbs 1:1
segments: ¶The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:2
segments: To know wisdom and instruction, To perceive the words of understanding,

entries.title: Proverbs 1:3
segments: To receive the instruction of wisdom, Justice, judgment, and equity;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:4
segments: To give prudence to the simple, To the young man knowledge and discretion-

entries.title: Proverbs 1:5
segments: A wise [man] will hear and increase learning, And a man of understanding will attain wise counsel,

entries.title: Proverbs 1:6
segments: To understand a proverb and an enigma, The words of the wise and their riddles.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:7
segments: ¶The fear of the LORD [is] the beginning of knowledge, [But] fools despise wisdom and instruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:8
segments: My son, hear the instruction of your father, And do not forsake the law of your mother;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:9
segments: For they [will be] a graceful ornament on your head, And chains about your neck.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:10
segments: ¶My son, if sinners entice you, Do not consent.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:11
segments: If they say, "Come with us, Let us lie in wait to [shed] blood; Let us lurk secretly for the innocent without cause;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:12
segments: Let us swallow them alive like Sheol, And whole, like those who go down to the Pit;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:13
segments: We shall find all [kinds] of precious possessions, We shall fill our houses with spoil;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:14
segments: Cast in your lot among us, Let us all have one purse" -

entries.title: Proverbs 1:15
segments: My son, do not walk in the way with them, Keep your foot from their path;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:16
segments: For their feet run to evil, And they make haste to shed blood.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:17
segments: Surely, in vain the net is spread In the sight of any bird;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:18
segments: But they lie in wait for their [own] blood, They lurk secretly for their [own] lives.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:19
segments: So [are] the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain; It takes away the life of its owners.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:20
segments: ¶Wisdom calls aloud outside; She raises her voice in the open squares.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:21
segments: She cries out in the chief concourses, At the openings of the gates in the city She speaks her words:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:22
segments: "How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? For scorners delight in their scorning, And fools hate knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:23
segments: Turn at my rebuke; Surely I will pour out my spirit on you; I will make my words known to you.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:24
segments: Because I have called and you refused, I have stretched out my hand and no one regarded,

entries.title: Proverbs 1:25
segments: Because you disdained all my counsel, And would have none of my rebuke,

entries.title: Proverbs 1:26
segments: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your terror comes,

entries.title: Proverbs 1:27
segments: When your terror comes like a storm, And your destruction comes like a whirlwind, When distress and anguish come upon you.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:28
segments: "Then they will call on me, but I will not answer; They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:29
segments: Because they hated knowledge And did not choose the fear of the LORD,

entries.title: Proverbs 1:30
segments: They would have none of my counsel [And] despised my every rebuke.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:31
segments: Therefore they shall eat the fruit of their own way, And be filled to the full with their own fancies.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:32
segments: For the turning away of the simple will slay them, And the complacency of fools will destroy them;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:33
segments: But whoever listens to me will dwell safely, And will be secure, without fear of evil."
